body:
Keep a small shelf of text snippets

Implements the approved design. Live release has not begun.

Linear: [SAC-246](https://linear.app/sachinkundu/issue/SAC-246/keep-a-small-shelf-of-text-snippets)

Approved Proposal and Specs: [PR #43](https://github.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/pull/43)

Approved design: [PR #44](https://github.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/pull/44)

The temporary Worker, D1 and R2 test environment is retired after publication. Screenshots and test evidence remain available here; no live review preview is retained.

Proof:

1. The newly migrated remote shelf opens empty on one desktop screen, with no login and the D1 + R2 cloud badge visible.

   ![The newly migrated remote shelf opens empty on one desktop screen, with no login and the D1 + R2 cloud badge visible.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/images/c302bcf125670ef3a4266b32492e2dc04065aeea198071e880545e80e9d00201.png)

2. Two cloud-backed snippets are listed, and selecting Sign-off shows its own Kind regards body.

   ![Two cloud-backed snippets are listed, and selecting Sign-off shows its own Kind regards body.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/images/0a820691fbaff9a69ccf5483a77b921e2fb60b6d0854086e5d9753e16f1b36d9.png)

3. After deleting Sign-off, Greeting remains listed and readable with Hello, team!.

   ![After deleting Sign-off, Greeting remains listed and readable with Hello, team!.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/images/ce40231ac0d97915449988764d9d832125b3220e833b381296768f083e4dd281.png)

4. A fresh browser context rebuilds the unchanged cloud shelf with Greeting listed, Sign-off absent, and no reader selection carried over.

   ![A fresh browser context rebuilds the unchanged cloud shelf with Greeting listed, Sign-off absent, and no reader selection carried over.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/images/e0bf2dd8a6c979dd00c6ccb2d72902eb30690d2668a65ea6733c49a30499dcea.png)

5. Selecting Greeting in the fresh context reads Hello, team! from the remote shelf.

   ![Selecting Greeting in the fresh context reads Hello, team! from the remote shelf.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/images/ce40231ac0d97915449988764d9d832125b3220e833b381296768f083e4dd281.png)

6. Submitting text without a title shows the title-required error and leaves Greeting as the only saved snippet.

   ![Submitting text without a title shows the title-required error and leaves Greeting as the only saved snippet.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/images/21721392e4d9f8d758f5164ec7b553f20e25c83eef36723e9312b980127e71b9.png)

7. Submitting Empty note with spaces-only text shows the text-required error and leaves the cloud shelf unchanged.

   ![Submitting Empty note with spaces-only text shows the text-required error and leaves the cloud shelf unchanged.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/images/87d7190b16b84299c9860c8b5ff4e5202a8df4ac897b02608166f06e861d772f.png)

8. Markup-looking content is displayed literally as \<b\>Hello\</b\> in the plain-text reader.

   ![Markup-looking content is displayed literally as \<b\>Hello\</b\> in the plain-text reader.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/images/c48187e034386527a03c936ed95b54b2394902d08e6da53e3af0bb06f17ccfbe.png)

9. A real remote save beyond the approved capacity is rejected with a clear no-capacity message, the form preserved, and no success state.

   ![A real remote save beyond the approved capacity is rejected with a clear no-capacity message, the form preserved, and no success state.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/images/c11f4a8a8e8c99dba19a5f93a09e2016813ae800ff4344a87dd244df376fe8e1.png)

This is the [Showboat file](https://github.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/blob/cce02a6093dc703264990b96746822a16c4cabec/showboat.md).
